Gumāni
poet of Patna.
--Upadeśaśataka, macaronic verses, with Nīti in one line an. illustration from Purāṇic themes in the other.

.
Pt.. (1) K. M. Gucch. II. p.. 20-28. (2) some verses with Eng. transl. published in Ind. Ant. XIV. p.. 124b. 206a. 236a. 261b. 292a. (3) with Hindi transl., Kāvyasaṅgraha, Almora, 1894.
--Kāvyasaṅgraha. collected poems.
See NCC. IV. p. 107a.

--Gumāninīti. ethical poem in 61 verses.
